findings.problem: The chip counts the conversation’s todo list, which the shipped zh-CN catalogue already calls 任务 on the surfaces this chip leads to: mobile.session.region.label_todos “任务” (en context: “Reuse the shipped tasks term”), relay.chrome.session.tray.tasks “任务{done}/{total}”, mobile.session.sheet_title.status “任务和智能体”. The translator note says 待办 keeps the chip “distinct from 任务 used elsewhere”, but that 任务 is this same todo list. 待办 is understandable, so MINOR, not MAJOR.

Two things. (a) 桌面端 does not match 桌面应用, the term used in the same sheet (tags.remove_all_body), in mobile.agent_avatar.edit_hint and in core relay.session.tags.empty_hint for the same feature. (b) 请 is not in the source (“Created on desktop.”), and the zh-CN style guide says to use 请 only where the English says please.
findings.suggestion: 需在桌面应用中创建。 (10 chars / 20 cells, within the 24 hint)

findings.problem: Fit: at count=99 the value is 7 chars but 11 cells (CJK glyphs are double width in the monospace meta strip), against the ~10 hint. The overflow is 1 cell, only at two-digit counts, and the context says this strip yields at large text, so nothing gets cut off. Dropping 个 to save space would not read naturally.
findings.suggestion: Keep the current wording. No shorter idiomatic form exists.

findings.problem: The translator note says no term for tag categories existed. Core zh-CN has one for the same tags sheet on the desktop relay: relay.session.tags.empty “尚无标签分类” (分类). Core is itself mixed, though: wire.errors.desktop.library_tag_category uses 标签类别. So 标签类别 is defensible and consistent within this batch.
findings.suggestion: No change required. If the corpus standardizes, use one term (标签类别 or 标签分类) in core and mobile.
